hero.title: Find your way across campus, step by step.
hero.lead: Just enter where you want to go — EPAC, the library, a lecture hall, the cafeteria — and let your guide walk you there.
how.title: Three steps, no detours.
how.s1.title: Enter your destination
how.s1.body: Type the place — a faculty, a lecture hall, the library — and pick it from the list.
how.s2.title: Get your route
how.s2.body: The shortest path appears on the map, with every turn clearly marked.
how.s3.title: Follow your guide
how.s3.body: Your avatar announces each step in real time, until you arrive.
feat.title: A travel companion for campus.
feat.a.title: Voice guide avatar
feat.a.body: A character tells you where to turn and locates you at every campus landmark.
feat.b.title: Interactive map
feat.b.body: See the shortest path between your position and your destination.
feat.c.title: Personal history
feat.c.body: Find your past searches and routes from your dashboard.
price.title: Simple, per search.
price.body: Two free searches, then pick a pack to keep going.
